reference: stdlib GPT-2 byte-level BPE plus the llama.cpp qwen2 split expression; see make_tokenizer_fixture.py
fuzz: the entries named fuzz-* are atom sequences drawn from FUZZ_ATOMS with splitmix64(0x20261012); the alphabet is fixed, so the selection is reproducible
columns: ids_plain is Encode(text, add_bos=false, parse_special=false) so only user-defined tokens resolve; ids_parse_special is Encode(text, false, true) so control tokens resolve too; pieces_hex is the split as `Encode` sees it: user-defined tokens whole, every other span split by the qwen2 expression, and merges never cross a piece
